args: import test from 'node:test'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {mkdtemp, writeFile, chmod, rm} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'; import {join} from 'node:path'; import {resolveBinary} from './src/resolve-binary.js'; const root=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'harness-v1-smoke-')); try { const exe=join(root,'exe'); const plain=join(root,'plain'); await writeFile(exe,'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'); await chmod(exe,0o755); await writeFile(plain,'not executable'); await chmod(plain,0o644); await test('executable resolves on PATH',()=>assert.equal(resolveBinary('exe',{PATH:root}),exe)); await test('non-executable is not resolved',()=>assert.equal(resolveBinary('plain',{PATH:root}),null)); await test('missing is not resolved',()=>assert.equal(resolveBinary('missing',{PATH:root}),null)); } finally { await rm(root,{recursive:true,force:true}); }
